parsed.rationale: 68-year-old with two weeks of worsening bilateral ankle edema plus new orthopnea/paroxysmal nocturnal dyspnea suggests decompensating heart failure. He needs same-day in-person evaluation (exam, vitals/oxygen saturation, ECG, chest imaging, labs) rather than async review; no report of resting severe dyspnea, chest pain, or syncope that would mandate immediate emergency activation, though worsening symptoms would escalate that need.
